description:
Title: Contract

For your contract project you need parts from several web shops.
In order to find out which web shop has the right parts, you have to query them all, and find out how much they can deliver, at which price, and how long it will take.
Create a list of parts that you order from each shop.
If one shop has not enough  parts, order from several shops.
Always use the cheapest parts.
The parts arrive in batches in a random order, typically they are +/- 2 days earlier/later.
When the first parts arrive you start building.
Sometimes you have to reorder parts.
If your stock (for a single part) falls below 5, you reorder (the cheapest), if it falls below 3 you reorder again (the fastest).
If it is zero, you write a mail to your friends, complaining about the webshops.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_Contract" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/contract" exporter="BPMN model generator" exporterVersion="2.0">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Query" name="Parts query"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Offers" name="Offers (quantity, price, delivery time)"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Order" name="Parts order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Batch" name="Parts batch delivery"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Reorder" name="Reorder request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Mail" name="Complaint mail about web shops"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Contract" name="Contract project">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Contract" name="Contract project" processRef="Process_Contract"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_WebShops" name="Web shops"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Friends" name="Friends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Query" name="Query parts" sourceRef="SendTask_QueryShops" targetRef="Participant_WebShops"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Offers" name="Offers" sourceRef="Participant_WebShops" targetRef="ReceiveTask_Offers"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_OrderCheapest" name="Order cheapest parts" sourceRef="SendTask_OrderCheapest" targetRef="Participant_WebShops"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_OrderRemaining" name="Order remaining parts" sourceRef="SendTask_OrderRemaining" targetRef="Participant_WebShops"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FirstParts" name="First batch" sourceRef="Participant_WebShops" targetRef="CatchEvent_FirstParts"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Batch" name="Batch" sourceRef="Participant_WebShops" targetRef="CatchEvent_Batch"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ReorderCheapest" name="Reorder cheapest" sourceRef="SendTask_ReorderCheapest" targetRef="Participant_WebShops"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ReorderFastest" name="Reorder fastest" sourceRef="SendTask_ReorderFastest" targetRef="Participant_WebShops"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Mail" name="Complaint" sourceRef="SendTask_Mail" targetRef="Participant_Friends"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Contract" name="Contract" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Contract" name="Parts needed for contract">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_Query</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_QueryShops" name="Query all web shops for parts" messageRef="Message_Query">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_Query</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Query_Offers</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="ReceiveTask_Offers" name="Receive offers (quantity, price, delivery time)" messageRef="Message_Offers">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Query_Offers</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Offers_Compare</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompareOffers" name="Compare offers">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Offers_Compare</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Compare_PartsList</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreatePartsList" name="Create list of cheapest parts per shop">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Compare_PartsList</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PartsList_Order</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_OrderCheapest" name="Order cheapest parts from one shop" messageRef="Message_Order">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PartsList_Order</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OrderCheapest_Check</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Sufficiency" name="Chosen shop covers full amount?" default="Flow_NotEnough">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OrderCheapest_Check</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Enough</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotEnough</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_OrderRemaining" name="Order remaining parts from several shops" messageRef="Message_Order">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotEnough</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OrderRemaining_Merge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Order_Merge" name="Orders placed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Enough</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OrderRemaining_Merge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Merge_Start</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Start_Split" name="Start building and monitor stock">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Merge_Start</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_FirstParts</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_Monitor</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="CatchEvent_FirstParts" name="First parts arrive">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_FirstParts</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FirstParts_Building</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDef_FirstParts" messageRef="Message_Batch"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_StartBuilding" name="Start building">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FirstParts_Building</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Building_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_BuildingStarted" name="Building started">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Building_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Monitor_Merge" name="Wait for next batch">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_Monitor</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Stock_NotBelow5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Stock_Ok3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Fastest_Back</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Monitor_Batch</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="CatchEvent_Batch" name="Batch of parts arrives">
      <bpmn:documentation>Parts arrive in batches in random order, typically +/- 2 days.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Monitor_Batch</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Batch_UpdateStock</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDef_Batch" messageRef="Message_Batch"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_UpdateStock" name="Update stock of the arrived part">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Batch_UpdateStock</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_UpdateStock_Below5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Below5" name="Stock below 5?" default="Flow_Stock_NotBelow5">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_UpdateStock_Below5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Below5_Yes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Stock_NotBelow5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_ReorderCheapest" name="Reorder cheapest parts" messageRef="Message_Reorder">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Below5_Yes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Cheapest_Below3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Below3" name="Stock below 3 or zero?" default="Flow_Stock_Ok3">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Cheapest_Below3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Zero</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Below3_Yes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Stock_Ok3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_ReorderFastest" name="Reorder fastest parts" messageRef="Message_Reorder">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Below3_Yes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Fastest_Back</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_Mail" name="Write mail to friends about web shops" messageRef="Message_Mail">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Zero</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Mail_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Complaint" name="Stock exhausted, complaint sent">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Mail_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Query" sourceRef="StartEvent_Contract" targetRef="SendTask_QueryShops"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Query_Offers" sourceRef="SendTask_QueryShops" targetRef="ReceiveTask_Offers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Offers_Compare" sourceRef="ReceiveTask_Offers" targetRef="Task_CompareOffers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Compare_PartsList" sourceRef="Task_CompareOffers" targetRef="Task_CreatePartsList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PartsList_Order" sourceRef="Task_CreatePartsList" targetRef="SendTask_OrderCheapest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderCheapest_Check" sourceRef="SendTask_OrderCheapest" targetRef="Gateway_Sufficiency"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Enough" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Sufficiency" targetRef="Gateway_Order_Merge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${chosenShopCoversFullAmount}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotEnough" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Sufficiency" targetRef="SendTask_OrderRemaining"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderRemaining_Merge" sourceRef="SendTask_OrderRemaining" targetRef="Gateway_Order_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Merge_Start" sourceRef="Gateway_Order_Merge" targetRef="Gateway_Start_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_FirstParts" sourceRef="Gateway_Start_Split" targetRef="CatchEvent_FirstParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Monitor" sourceRef="Gateway_Start_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Monitor_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FirstParts_Building" sourceRef="CatchEvent_FirstParts" targetRef="Task_StartBuilding"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Building_End" sourceRef="Task_StartBuilding" targetRef="EndEvent_BuildingStarted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Monitor_Batch" sourceRef="Gateway_Monitor_Merge" targetRef="CatchEvent_Batch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Batch_UpdateStock" sourceRef="CatchEvent_Batch" targetRef="Task_UpdateStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UpdateStock_Below5" sourceRef="Task_UpdateStock" targetRef="Gateway_Below5"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Below5_Yes" name="Stock below 5" sourceRef="Gateway_Below5" targetRef="SendTask_ReorderCheapest">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${stock < 5}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Stock_NotBelow5" name="Stock 5 or more" sourceRef="Gateway_Below5" targetRef="Gateway_Monitor_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Cheapest_Below3" sourceRef="SendTask_ReorderCheapest" targetRef="Gateway_Below3"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Zero" name="Stock is zero" sourceRef="Gateway_Below3" targetRef="SendTask_Mail">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${stock == 0}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Below3_Yes" name="Stock below 3" sourceRef="Gateway_Below3" targetRef="SendTask_ReorderFastest">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${stock > 0 && stock < 3}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Stock_Ok3" name="Stock 3 or more" sourceRef="Gateway_Below3" targetRef="Gateway_Monitor_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Fastest_Back" sourceRef="SendTask_ReorderFastest" targetRef="Gateway_Monitor_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Mail_End" sourceRef="SendTask_Mail" targetRef="EndEvent_Complaint"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
